#### Principles:

+---------------+--------------------------------+
| Goals         | - No hypoxia                   |
|               | - No barotrauma                |
|               | - No explosion                 |
+---------------+--------------------------------+
| Supply design | - Multiple oxygen sources      |
|               | - Multiple pressure regulators |
|               | - Multiple alarms              |
+---------------+--------------------------------+

#### Oxygen sources:

+----------+-----------------------------------------------+
| Cylinder | - Label                                       |
|          | - Colour code: white body, white shoulders    |
|          | - Pin index safety system (2&5)               |
|          | - Outlet melts and occludes if heated         |
|          | - Bodok seal – non-combustible, gas-tight     |
+----------+-----------------------------------------------+
| Pipeline | - Label: socket and hose                      |
|          | - Colour code: white hose, white screw collar |
|          | - Diameter index safety system                |
|          | - Anti-kink tube                              |
+----------+-----------------------------------------------+

#### Anaesthesia machine:

+--------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Fresh gas supply   | - Oxygen is the last to enter the stream                                  |
|                    | - Oxygen control knob (if present) is colour coded, larger, protuberant   |
|                    | - Chain-link between O~2~ and N~2~O flowmeters (physical or electronic)   |
|                    | - Oxygen failure (usually \<2atm) → open fail-safe valve, other gas off   |
|                    | - Usually no protection against hypoxia from low FiO~2~ with low FGF rate |
+--------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Alternative supply | *N.B. no electricity required:*                                           |
|                    |                                                                           |
|                    | - Oxygen safety flow (0-10L/min)                                          |
|                    |   - Into fresh gas supply                                                 |
|                    |   - Master control switch must be on                                      |
|                    | - Oxygen flush (40-60L/min, 4 atm)                                        |
|                    |   - Bypasses circuit                                                      |
|                    |   - Button in-set to prevent accidental barotrauma                        |
|                    | - Auxiliary source (0-10L/min)                                            |
|                    |   - Separate to circuit                                                   |
|                    | - Bag-mask resuscitator                                                   |
|                    |   - Separate to machine                                                   |
+--------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Pressure           | - Systems:                                                                |
|                    |   - High (16atm) – cylinder and attachments                               |
|                    |   - Intermediate (4atm) – gas supply lines                                |
|                    |   - Low (\<70cmH~2~O) – fresh gas, vapourisers, circuit\                  |
|                    |     (i.e. patient interface)                                              |
|                    | - Valves:                                                                 |
|                    |   - Check valves – prevent backflow                                       |
|                    |   - Pressure regulators – smooth pressure drop between sections           |
|                    |   - Pressure relief valves – e.g. APL valve 0-70cmH~2~O                   |
+--------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Power              | - Wall source (connected to uninterruptable supply)                       |
|                    | - Back-up battery                                                         |
|                    | - On-off button in-set                                                    |
+--------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Alarms             | - Power supply                                                            |
|                    | - Pressure gauges                                                         |
|                    | - FiO~2~ and etO~2~ – paramagnetic analyser                               |
|                    | - Oxygen failure – activated if supply \<2atm, cannot be silenced         |
+--------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
